properties.note: Pre-reaction Lewis adduct H3B<-O=CH2 (B-O 1.666 A, C=O 1.217 A); lowest-energy minimum of a four-start conformer survey. Two IRC-endpoint re-optimizations from the bidirectional IRC outer frames reproduce the same minimum (E = -141.041123993 Ha).

Four-membered B-H-C-O hydride-transfer saddle: B-O 1.772, C-O 1.235, B-H(hydride) 1.238, H...C 2.134 A. Imaginary mode is the B-H breaking / C-H forming coordinate. Reproduced independently in the ts_prepare run (-398.5894 cm-1).
Methoxyborane CH3-O-BH2: B-O 1.340 A, C-O 1.415 A, B...H(hydride) 3.14 A. Four rotamers surveyed; single relevant minimum. IRC-endpoint re-optimizations reproduce it at E = -141.113509073 Ha.

Bidirectional IRC (26 frames per direction) from the verified saddle: one side relaxes to the H3B<-O=CH2 adduct, the other to CH3-O-BH2; outer frames re-optimized with frequencies give 0-imaginary minima identical to RC and P.
